description: Display an image using a wiki file or verified archive sources.
documentation_wikitext: Display an image using a wiki file or verified archive sources. == Usage == {{Image|file=Milady.jpg|frame=thumb|alt=Milady avatar|caption=Milady avatar}} For an uploaded file, supply file (or positional parameter 1). MediaWiki supplies the file link and its native image or media presentation. Use ordinary [[File:...]] syntax when a reusable template is unnecessary. For a source held in an archive, omit file and supply the archive identity parameters below. Source filenames and SHA-256 values must match the archive's retained records; imports should fill these fields from verified source bindings. The storage backend does not change the template's purpose.

examples.description: An archived thumbnail with native alignment, parsed caption wikitext, filename-derived alt text, and a bounded display width.
examples.invocation:
{{Image
| site = example-site
| sha256 = 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
| filename = Diagram sample.png
| frame = thumb
| align = left
| caption = Diagram with an ''emphasized'' caption.
| width = 320
}}

parameters.description: Uploaded media filename, with or without File:. Use this or archive sources.
parameters.label: Wiki file
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: Exact lowercase SHA-256 of the archived image object.
parameters.label: Object SHA-256
parameters.name: sha256

parameters.description: Exact source-record filename for this occurrence; verified against the archived object and used for filename-derived alternative text.
parameters.label: Source filename
parameters.name: filename

parameters.description: Optional MediaWiki horizontal alignment. Any explicit value uses block presentation; none requests an un-floated block, while omission keeps an unframed image inline.
parameters.label: Alignment
parameters.name: align

parameters.description: Optional wikitext caption. Block or framed presentation displays it; inline presentation uses its plain text as the file-link title and fallback alternative text.
parameters.label: Caption
parameters.name: caption

parameters.description: Alternative text. Omission or an empty non-decorative value derives accessible text from the filename.
parameters.label: Alternative text
parameters.name: alt

parameters.description: Set to yes only for an evidenced decorative image and leave alt empty.
parameters.label: Decorative
parameters.name: decorative

parameters.description: Maximum display width in whole pixels, from 1 to 16384.
parameters.label: Width
parameters.name: width

parameters.description: Maximum display height in whole pixels, from 1 to 16384.
parameters.label: Height
parameters.name: height
